outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo, not a plot showing averages; not applicable to this check.
Bar/mean plot of inhibition zone percentages shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid for each condition (right side of panel B is a photograph of plates, not a plot).
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot; check not applicable.
Fluorescence intensity plot shows mean ± SEM with individual yellow circles representing single cells overlaid for each group.
Fluorescence intensity plot (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual blue circles representing single cells overlaid for each group.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM micrograph images of individual cells, not a plot of averaged data.
Plot of number of PacL2 clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots representing individual cells.
Cluster size plot (log scale) shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots representing individual clusters.
Plot of molecule percentage into clusters shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots representing individual cells.
